function.name: list_tasks
function.description: List tasks in a project with filtering

project_id.description: ID of the project to list tasks from

status.description: Optional list of statuses to filter by (Backlog/Todo/In Progress/Done/Canceled)

assigned_to.description: Optional user to filter tasks assigned to

function.name: get_task_details
function.description: Get detailed information about a task with optional format conversion

task_id.description: ID of the task to get details for
ID of the task to update

description.description:
New description in markdown format. Supports standard markdown syntax including:
- Headers (# ## ###)
- Lists (- * 1.)
- Code blocks (```language)
- Tables (| --- |)
- Links and images
- Bold, italic, strikethrough
- Task lists (- [ ] - [x])

function.name: get_user_tasks
function.description: Get tasks assigned to a specific user with optional filtering

user_id.description: ID of the user to get tasks for

status.description: Optional list of statuses to filter by

project_id.description: Optional project ID to filter tasks from

function.name: create_task_dependency
function.description: Create a dependency relationship between two tasks

depends_on_task_id.description: ID of the task that blocks this task

analysis_reason.description: Internal analysis explanation for creating this dependency

function.name: get_task_dependencies
function.description: Get list of dependencies for a specific task

task_id.description: ID of the task to get dependencies for

function.name: analyze_critical_path
function.description: Analyze critical path for project tasks to identify bottlenecks and dependencies

project_id.description: ID of the project to analyze

function.name: find_similar_tasks
function.description: Find historically similar tasks and analyze their estimation patterns

task_id.description: ID of the task to analyze

project_id.description: ID of the project to list pages from

function.name: get_webpage_content
function.description: Fetches webpage content and converts it to markdown format. Supports both external URLs and Frappe document URLs.

url.description: URL of the webpage to fetch

function.name: web_search
function.description: Perform a web search using Google Custom Search API

num_results.description: Number of results to return (default: 5, max: 10)

function.name: get_discussion_comments
function.description: Get comments from a discussion with optional filtering by time

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return

before_id.description: Get comments before this comment ID (optional)

after_id.description: Get comments after this comment ID (optional)
